rationale: Artem brings deep ML infrastructure expertise (efficient inference, transformer architectures, vision-language models) that directly complements Shiza's work on humanoid robotics and computer vision at Haptile—she's building hardware that needs the kind of optimized ML systems he specializes in. Both are hands-on builders with overlapping technical stacks (Python, C++, computer vision) and conviction that proximity to smart people and building at the frontier drives real progress, making them natural collaborators on the ML-robotics frontier.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Shiza Charania — you're both deep in computer vision and ML systems, and her humanoid robotics work at Haptile could benefit from your expertise in efficient inference and transformer architectures.
